_about: Шаблоны наших тулзов Ultravox. Панель (вкладка Ultravox → Тулзы) строит из них тулзы: адрес = TOOLS_PUBLIC_URL + path, ключ X-AVR-Key = TOOLS_API_KEY, uv_call_id = ID звонка (P-02). {COMPANY_NAME}, {CLIENT_ID_LABEL}, {CLIENT_ID_FORMAT} — из .env. requires: billing | network — тулз подключается к агентам, только если включён BILLING_PROVIDER / NETWORK_SOURCE. Правки конкретной установки панель хранит в instance/ultravox/tools.json поверх этого файла.

tools.name: searchFAQ
tools.description:
Search the {COMPANY_NAME} support FAQ. Call it for any caller question or problem before answering yourself.
query: the caller's question in their own words. lang: "ro" or "ru" (the caller's language).
Result: if data.found, say data.answer naturally in the caller's language, without adding details.
If data.requires_client_id, ask for the {CLIENT_ID_LABEL} code ({CLIENT_ID_FORMAT}), then call findByClientId.
If not found or error, do not guess: offer a callback from a specialist.

schema.description: The user's question in natural language
Language code: 'ro' for Romanian or 'ru' for Russian

tools.name: findByClientId
tools.description:
Find the caller in the billing system by {CLIENT_ID_LABEL} code. Call it after the caller gives their {CLIENT_ID_LABEL} code ({CLIENT_ID_FORMAT}).
Returns client_name, client_type, client_ip, is_active (service active), is_paid (no unpaid invoices).
If data.found is false or the code is invalid, ask the caller to repeat the code once; if still not found, offer a callback.
If is_active is false or is_paid is false, tell the caller politely (contract inactive / unpaid invoice) before any technical check.
If client_ip is empty, do not call getNetworkData; offer a callback from a technician.

tools.name: getNetworkData
tools.description:
Get the client's network data by the client IP returned by findByClientId.
Returns mac_address, switch_name, switch_ip, port, pop, can_diagnose.
Call diagnoseClient only if can_diagnose is true (switch_ip AND mac_address are present). Never use the client IP as switch_ip.
If can_diagnose is false, do not run diagnostics: tell the caller a technician will check the line and offer a callback.

schema.description: Client IP address from findByClientId result

tools.name: diagnoseClient
tools.description:
Check the client's connection on the network switch: port state and whether the client's device (MAC) is visible.
Use switch_ip, mac_address, switch_name and port exactly as returned by getNetworkData. Never pass the client IP as switch_ip.
The check takes a few seconds: tell the caller you are checking the line before calling.
Result: data.port_status "down" -> the line/port is down, a technician must check; data.mac_found false -> the client's router seems off or disconnected, ask the caller to check power and restart it;
mac_found true and port up -> the connection is OK on our side.
If the tool returns an error (including code SWITCH_IP_UNKNOWN), do not retry: offer a callback from a technician.

schema.description: IP address of the network switch (from findByContract result)
Name of the network switch (from findByContract result)

tools.name: updateCall
tools.description:
Save information gathered during the conversation to the current call record (sent to Telegram when the call ends).
Use call_id "latest". Send only the fields you learned.
request_summary: one sentence in the caller's own words describing the reason for the call - send it as soon as you understand the problem, never the FAQ answer.
resolution: what you told or recommended to the caller, or how the case ended.
Set needs_callback true (with callback_reason) whenever you promise the caller a callback.

schema.description: Call ID or 'latest' for current call
Whether MAC was found on switch
AI's assessment of the possible cause
One short sentence in the caller's language describing what the caller asked (e.g. "Nu are internet de azi dimineata"). Send it as soon as the problem is clear.
What you told or recommended to the caller, or how the case ended (e.g. 'Recomandat reboot router').
